next.reason: §2023:12.3.7.4 GR12 restates the exclusive character set, numeric literal = ordinal number, nonnumeric literal = the characters (each of a multi-character literal), and THROUGH in either order; §2023:12.3.7.3 SR17 bounds the ordinal by the size of the character set. 1985's 'Class-name-1 can be referenced only in a class condition' is not restated: 2023 also admits class-name-1 in the data-division CLASS clause (§2023:13.18.11.4 GR1, VALIDATE only), syntax that does not exist in 1985, and no other 1985 format can hold a class-name, so a conforming 1985 program is accepted and means the same.
